name: skillvault-upsert
title: SkillVault Upsert
description: Create or edit skill source files and catalog entries in the SkillVault repo, from scratch or a URL; can install the result afterward.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: nameOrUrl
inputs.description: Existing repository skill name to edit, new skill name to create from scratch, or source URL to derive a skill from. A name does not automatically import an installed copy.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: Install scope after upsert. default means auto-guess from the created skill manifest. none means do not install.
